title: mini-audit research-delta
description: The only channel through which an agent contributes to canonical research state (Search Governance v1, R2-1). Objects are addressed by semantic key; the runtime allocates canonical ids. Applied all-or-nothing — a schema error, an unresolvable reference or an identity conflict rejects the whole delta and leaves every artifact untouched. Re-applying the same delta is a no-op, so 'apply twice' is safe. Unknown top-level fields are rejected rather than ignored: a misspelled `capabilites_add` would otherwise be accepted and silently do nothing, which looks exactly like success.

decisions.description: Decision-provenance log (spec §5). Every semantic mutation an agent makes on canonical state must be recorded here. The runtime canonicalizes the entry into the ledger's decisions array; subsequent attempts to write the same decision_id are a no-op. A semantic mutation made without a decision_id is rejected by the runtime.

diff_evidence_ref.description: Pointer to the diff-scope.json artifact that justifies this fact in an incremental round (the form is 'diff-scope.json:scope_type=…:baseline=…:target=…'). The runtime stores it on the ledger fact so the L7 closure gate can tell 'changed code' evidence from 'unchanged code' evidence.
Pointer to the diff-scope.json artifact that triggered this assumption (incremental rounds). Without it a 'disproved' status has no machine-readable connection to the change-set that disproved it.

ref.description: Semantic key or canonical id (A-…) of an assumption that must already exist. An update never creates.

diff_evidence_ref.description: Pointer to the diff-scope.json artifact that triggered this status change. Required when status is 'disproved' in a diff round, optional otherwise.

name.description: Identity field, together with principal. The same name held by a different principal is a different capability.

principal.description: Identity field. Defaults to the canonical objective's principal when omitted, so the identity stays deterministic without the author repeating it.

CapabilityUpdate.description: Change a capability that already exists, addressed by key or canonical id. Identity fields (`name`, `principal`) are deliberately absent: changing them means a different capability, which needs a new key rather than an update.

from.description: Node id (PRIN-/CAP-/GOAL-) or the semantic key of a capability created in the same delta — forward references resolve before anything is written.

via_candidate.description: Identity field when present. This is how a candidate becomes the provenance of a graph edge without the finding having to carry a candidate list.

EdgeUpdate.description: Change an edge that already exists — typically promoting a frontier edge from `proposed` to `verified`. Identity (`from`/`to`/`relation`/`via_candidate`) is absent for the same reason as in CapabilityUpdate: re-declaring an edge through `edges_add` means restating all of it, and forgetting `via_candidate` turns a status change into a provenance conflict.

candidate_id.description: Candidates keep their existing author-supplied ids; they are not migrated onto semantic keys. The patch must resolve to a real candidate — an orphan update is refused.

local_validity.description: Whether the local bug is real — a different axis from the candidate's security verdict.

Decision.description: Decision provenance (spec §5). Every entry MUST carry a non-empty decision_id and decided_by; the runtime refuses to canonicalize entries without them. The decision_id is the only top-level field the agent mints and the runtime canonicalizes — runtime-generated fields go under the derived.* / system.* / validation.* namespaces and must not appear here.

decision_id.description: Globally-unique, monotonic id allocated by the agent (e.g. DEC-0042). Re-applying the same decision_id is a no-op so retries are safe.

decided_by.description: Who took the decision (agent id or harness name). The runtime refuses entries where this is empty or 'runtime'.

phase.description: The audit phase the decision was made under (L5, V3, etc.). Recorded so an audit report can correlate a decision with the phase that produced it.

semantic_mutation.description: The kind of canonical mutation this decision authorizes. The runtime checks the entry against the rest of the delta and refuses mismatches (e.g. a decision of kind 'blocked_path_reopen' with no matching blocked_paths_reopen entry is rejected).

reason.description: Free-text rationale. Mandatory — a decision without a reason is refused (spec §5).

evidence_refs.description: Line-grounded evidence supporting the decision. Empty list is allowed only when semantic_mutation is 'audit_stop'.

subject_ref.description: The semantic key or canonical id of the object the decision acts on (e.g. 'blocked:query-needs-scalar', 'cand-031'). Not strictly required for every kind but strongly recommended.
